items.q: Lawrence Welk for instance, who has a wonderful organization that he plays all kinds of popular melodies

ctx.x: Like the difference being so that

anyone else could understand is like Lawrence Welk for instance, who has a wonderful organization that he plays all kinds of popular melodies, and people can understand his music who like melodies and who like to dance just ordinary dancing or socializing. And remember the old songs.

You see, there's a difference in the music he plays and jazz music inasmuch as it is all music, but it has a different expression. And it's almost like a language. It is. I'm convinced that jazz music is like a language, and you have to speak that language to understand it. And so consequently the people who speak that language, or like anybody else who speaks a foreign language and finds somebody who understands their language like for instance they're happy to see them. Oh, hey, you know. And it's the same way…
